text:
priya: Heads-up — scheduling a tenant-scoped schema migration in the 22:15 UTC change window. Deploybot queued job `mig-tenant-shadow-2026-03`. Plan: stagger by tenant ranges, canary 10 tenants, then wave-based backfill. Dry-run showed row-locking risk; proposing a strict rollback/escape-hatch and pinned runner version schema:v3.2.1. Need signoffs.

maria: paste the dry-run logs? what lock exactly showed up?

priya: sure, snippet below from the dry-run (shortened):
```
[2026-03-21T18:02:12Z] worker-3: starting backfill tenant_range [1000-1999]
[2026-03-21T18:02:26Z] worker-3: executing DDL: ALTER TABLE tenants ADD COLUMN last_active_ts bigint;
[2026-03-21T18:02:26Z] db: waiting for lock (12s)
[2026-03-21T18:02:38Z] db: acquired ROW SHARE lock (duration 12s)
[2026-03-21T18:02:58Z] worker-3: backfill batch 12 complete, pause checkpoint
```
Looks like the dry-run used a conservative DDL path; we can avoid ACCESS EXCLUSIVE by ensuring no default expressions and using chunked UPDATEs for backfill.

db-ops: that log shows ROW SHARE/ROW EXCLUSIVE-ish waits. Not ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, but still can block heavy writers. Two mitigation options: (1) convert to implicit-add-column + async backfill (what we tested) or (2) run CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY style approach for heavy ops. Which DDL will prod use?

priya: We're doing implicit add + async backfill (no locking default). Backfill is a separate job that uses per-tenant checkpoints and pauses after each wave. Commands to abort/rollback are below. Escape hatch must be clear: if locks exceed threshold or error rate spikes, abort immediately.

jon: Proposal for rollback criteria: abort if any of the following during canary or wave 1:
- any lock wait > 30s on tenants table
- error rate for write path > 1% sustained for 2 minutes
- p95 write latency > 500ms for DB ops to tenants sharded hosts
If any trigger hits, immediate abort + stop further waves. Agree?

priya: Agreed. Escape commands:
```
# stop the migration gracefully
deploybot abort-migration mig-tenant-shadow-2026-03 --reason "lock-threshold-exceeded"
# if abort fails, force rollback (drain backfills and remove new column from app feature flag)
deploybot rollback-migration --id mig-tenant-shadow-2026-03 --force
```

deploy-bot: [automation] Migration created: mig-tenant-shadow-2026-03 — state: scheduled -> canary. Holdpoint at canary_end webhook. Notifications to channel on holdpoint and abort. :construction_worker:

maria: adding release-notes & runbook link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-tenantid-shadow (internal). I'll include the rollback triggers and the per-tenant checkpoint instructions.

priya: I'm pinning the migration runner to schema:v3.2.1 in the deploy config and enabling the `tourniquet` feature-flag for throttling backfills. @maria @jon @db-ops please ack.

maria: ack :thumbsup:

jon: ack. also please set `max_concurrent_backfills=2` per worker and `backfill_chunk_ms=500` in runtime overrides so we reduce lock contention.

priya: done — config snippet: `runner.version=schema:v3.2.1, max_concurrent_backfills=2, backfill_chunk_ms=500, tourniquet=true`

db-ops: I'll watch lock stats and p95s during canary. Oncall alerted if any threshold crosses. If we see sustained lock >30s, I'll trigger the abort and post the reason.

deploy-bot: [automation] Canary start: mig-tenant-shadow-2026-03 — canary group size: 10 tenants. Expected duration ~ 8m. Will post canary_end metrics to this thread.

(priya later) deploy-bot posted canary_end: 10 tenants processed — max observed lock wait 28s, write error rate 0.2%, p95 write latency 320ms. Canary PASSED. Proceeding to Wave 1 (tenant ranges [2000-4999]).

maria: copying the final rollback criteria into release notes: 
- lock_wait > 30s -> abort
- write_error_rate > 1% sustained 2m -> abort
- p95_write_latency > 500ms -> abort
Also noted that safe-mode toggle is `tourniquet` and that backfill is resumable per-tenant.

jon: green to proceed, db-ops will escalate if anything weird. Good to document post-mortem checkpoints (who to ping if wave stalls).

priya: starting Wave 1 now (kicking off jobs for ranges). Will update when wave completes or if abort happens.

db-ops: watching — ping me in thread if you see long locks or increased retries.

(End of thread)
